exposure: Hospital-based online audit and feedback programme
outcome: Rates of induction for postdates in women less than 41 weeks at delivery
Rates of repeat caesarean delivery in low-risk women performed before 39 weeks
Rates of appropriately timed group B streptococcus screening
Rates of unsatisfactory newborn screening blood samples
Rates of formula supplementation at discharge
cohort: The study utilized population-based data from the provincial birth registry for women receiving maternal-newborn care in all 94 hospitals in Ontario, Canada, between November 2009 and March 2015.
finding: An electronic audit and feedback program in maternal-newborn hospitals was associated with clinically relevant practice improvements at the provincial level for the majority of targeted performance indicators.
mod_finding: The intervention was associated with statistically significant absolute decreases in the rates of episiotomy and repeat caesarean delivery in low-risk women performed before 39 weeks.
